title: Validation MCP GitHub issue sync is blocked by UTF-8 BOM bug JSON parse errors
description: Expected: Validation MCP BUG registry readers and GitHub issue sync tools must tolerate UTF-8 BOM in existing BUG JSON files, matching the already hardened CLI behavior that reads with utf-8-sig. A BOM-encoded or malformed unrelated registry record must not block listing, searching, or syncing another BUG. Actual: current Validation MCP calls still abort globally when any scanned BUG registry JSON is encoded with UTF-8 BOM; observed on 2026-05-23 while syncing BUG-101/#165, where mcp_github_issue_search and mcp_github_issue_sync_bug failed on F:/Dev/AIstock_worktrees/qe-mcp-template-archive-20260516/tests/aistock_validation/bugs/20260520_BUG-077-miniqmt-strategy-execution-bypasses-strategypackage-minute-e.json with Unexpected UTF-8 BOM. This issue was previously tracked as BUG-088/#116 in a stale worktree, but BUG-088 is already used in origin/main for a MiniQMT lifecycle issue; the canonical tracking ID is now BUG-102 while retaining GitHub issue #116.

trigger_condition.current_error: Failed to read bug JSON registry entry ... Unexpected UTF-8 BOM (decode using utf-8-sig)
trigger_condition.conflict_reason: origin/main already uses BUG-088 for paper-v2 live approval lifecycle missing for MiniQMT live

reproduce_command: Run Validation MCP mcp_github_issue_search or mcp_github_issue_sync_bug while the configured/scanned BUG registry contains a UTF-8 BOM encoded JSON file such as F:/Dev/AIstock_worktrees/qe-mcp-template-archive-20260516/tests/aistock_validation/bugs/20260520_BUG-077-miniqmt-strategy-execution-bypasses-strategypackage-minute-e.json; observe the MCP call aborts with Unexpected UTF-8 BOM (decode using utf-8-sig).
required_verification: Validation MCP mcp_github_issue_search works when an unrelated BUG JSON has UTF-8 BOM
Validation MCP mcp_github_issue_sync_bug can sync a target BUG while another registry file has UTF-8 BOM
Confirm BUG-102 JSON and GitHub issue #116 remain synchronized after fix branch/commit is known
closure_requirements: BUG/finding JSON readers tolerate UTF-8 BOM or isolate parse failures without aborting unrelated sync operations.
Health/summary still reports parse diagnostics for genuinely invalid JSON.
mcp_github_issue_search/list/sync do not abort globally because of one unrelated BOM-encoded BUG JSON.
Regression tests include BOM-encoded BUG JSON fixtures for both local registry search and sync paths.
GitHub issue #116 and BUG-102 registry record are updated with fix branch, commit, and validation evidence before closure.

events.note: Original BOM registry sync blocker was discovered and mirrored to GitHub issue #116, but the local BUG ID conflicted with a different BUG-088 in origin/main.
Canonical registry ID corrected to BUG-102; GitHub issue #116 retained and reopened for current MCP regression/activation gap. No code fix is included in this registry-sync branch.
